articles.summary: GLENVILLE, N.Y., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of TrustCo Bank Corp NY (TrustCo, Nasdaq: TRST) on November 17, 2026 declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share, or $1.60 per share on an annualized basis. The dividend will be payable on January 4, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026. Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer Robert J. McCormick said: “Each November Trustco Bank celebrates its “Month of Thanks” to show appreciation to the Bank’s customers with specials and giveaways. We also are thankful that corporate performance continues to support our long-standing commitment to the payment of a meaningful dividend to our owners. articles.title: TrustCo Declares Quarterly Dividend on the Heels of Strong Quarterly Results
